/**
 * @module MoneroPaymentForm
 * ES6 module for integrating Monero payments into web checkout flows.
 */

const DEBUG_TAG = "[MoneroPayment]";

/**
 * @constant {string}
 */
const MONERO_PAYMENT_TEMPLATE = `
<div id="wrap">
    <div class="oe_website_sale o_website_sale_checkout container py-2">
        <div class="container mt-4 light-mode">
            <div class="row justify-content-center">
                <div class="col-md-12 text-center">
                    <h2>Pay with Monero</h2>
                    <div class="alert" id="payment_status_alert">
                        <h4><span id="payment_amount_str"></span> XMR</h4>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-4 border p-3">
                        <img id="qr_code_img" class="img-fluid" style="max-width: 250px" alt="Monero QR Code"/>
                    </div>
                    <div class="alert" id="payment_status_message">
                        <span id="status_message"></span>
                        <div id="status_check_container" style="display:none">
                            <a href="#" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="check_status_btn">
                                Check Payment Status
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-left border-top pt-3">
                        <h5>How to Pay:</h5>
                        <ol>
                            <li>Open your Monero wallet</li>
                            <li>Send the exact amount to the address above</li>

                        </ol>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
`;

/**
 * Utility functions for HTTP requests and translations
 */
class Utils {
    /**
     * Make an RPC call to the server
     * @param {string} endpoint 
     * @param {Object} data 
     * @param {Object} options 
     * @returns {Promise<Object>}
     */
    static async rpc(endpoint, data = {}, options = {}) {
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': this.getCSRFToken(),
                ...options.headers
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(data),
            signal: options.timeout ? AbortSignal.timeout(options.timeout) : undefined
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
        }

        return await response.json();
    }

    /**
     * Get CSRF token from meta tag or cookies
     * @returns {string}
     */
    static getCSRFToken() {
        // Try meta tag first
        const metaTag = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
        if (metaTag) return metaTag.getAttribute('content');

        // Try cookie
        const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (let cookie of cookies) {
            const [name, value] = cookie.trim().split('=');
            if (name === 'csrftoken') return value;
        }

        return '';
    }

    /**
     * Simple translation function (can be replaced with i18n library)
     * @param {string} text 
     * @returns {string}
     */
    static translate(text) {
        // This is a placeholder - replace with actual translation logic
        const translations = {
            "Pay with Monero": "Pay with Monero",
            "Pay Now": "Pay Now",
            "Payment Error": "Payment Error",
            "OK": "OK"
        };
        return translations[text] || text;
    }

    /**
     * Load external JavaScript
     * @param {string} src 
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     */
    static loadJS(src) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = src;
            script.onload = resolve;
            script.onerror = reject;
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Show a modal dialog
     * @param {string} title 
     * @param {string} message 
     */
    static showDialog(title, message) {
        // Simple alert - can be replaced with modal library
        alert(`${title}: ${message}`);
    }

    /**
     * Block UI (show loading)
     */
    static blockUI() {
        document.body.style.cursor = 'wait';
        document.body.classList.add('loading');
    }

    /**
     * Unblock UI (hide loading)
     */
    static unblockUI() {
        document.body.style.cursor = '';
        document.body.classList.remove('loading');
    }
}

/**
 * The Monero Payment Form class integrates Monero payments into web checkout pages.
 */
export class MoneroPaymentForm {
    /**
     * Create a MoneroPaymentForm instance
     * @param {string|Element} selector - CSS selector or DOM element
     */
    constructor(selector) {
        console.debug(`${DEBUG_TAG} Initializing payment form widget`);
        
        this.element = typeof selector === 'string' ? document.querySelector(selector) : selector;
        if (!this.element) {
            throw new Error(`Element not found: ${selector}`);
        }

        this.moneroPaymentContainer = null;
        this.clipboard = null;
        this.statusCheckInterval = null;
        this.moneroSelected = false;
        this.currentPaymentId = null;
        this.submitButton = null;

        // Bind methods to maintain context
        this._boundOnSubmitPayment = this._onSubmitPayment.bind(this);
        this._boundOnPaymentMethodSelected = this._onPaymentMethodSelected.bind(this);
    }

    /**
     * Initialize the payment form
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     */
    async init() {
        try {
            // Load dependencies
            await Promise.allSettled([
                Utils.loadJS('/payment_monero_rpc/static/src/js/clipboard.min.js')
                    .catch(e => console.error(`${DEBUG_TAG} Failed to load clipboard.js:`, e))
            ]);

            this._setupEventListeners();
            this._handleInitialSelection();
            
            console.debug(`${DEBUG_TAG} Payment form initialized successfully`);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`${DEBUG_TAG} Initialization failed:`, error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Set up event listeners
     * @private
     */
    _setupEventListeners() {
        // Find submit button
        this.submitButton = document.querySelector('button[name="o_payment_submit_button"]') ||
                           this.element.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');

        if (this.submitButton) {
            this.submitButton.addEventListener('click', this._boundOnSubmitPayment);
        }

        // Listen for payment method changes
        const paymentRadios = this.element.querySelectorAll('input[name="o_payment_radio"]');
        paymentRadios.forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', this._boundOnPaymentMethodSelected);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Handle initial payment method selection on page load
     * @private
     */
    _handleInitialSelection() {
        const selectedRadio = this.element.querySelector('input[name="o_payment_radio"]:checked');
        if (selectedRadio) {
            this._onPaymentMethodSelected({ currentTarget: selectedRadio });
        }
    }

    /**
     * Handle payment method selection change
     * @param {Event} event
     * @private
     */
    _onPaymentMethodSelected(event) {
        const providerCode = this._getProviderCode(event.currentTarget);
        this.moneroSelected = (providerCode === 'monero_rpc');
        this._updatePayButtonText(this.moneroSelected ? Utils.translate("Pay with Monero") : Utils.translate("Pay Now"));
    }

    /**
     * Handle form submission for Monero payments
     * @param {Event} event
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     * @private
     */
    async _onSubmitPayment(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        if (!this.moneroSelected) {
            // Let other payment methods handle submission
            return;
        }

        try {
            this._disablePaymentForm();
            const checkedRadio = this.element.querySelector('input[name="o_payment_radio"]:checked');
            const paymentResponse = await this._processMoneroPayment(checkedRadio);

            if (paymentResponse.error) {
                throw new Error(paymentResponse.error);
            }
            
            if (!paymentResponse.payment_id) {
                throw new Error("Invalid payment data received");
            }

            const paymentData = paymentResponse.payment || {};
            paymentData.payment_id = paymentResponse.payment_id;
            await this._displayMoneroPaymentPage(paymentData);

        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`${DEBUG_TAG} Payment error:`, error);
            Utils.showDialog(Utils.translate("Payment Error"), error.message);
            this._enablePaymentForm();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Process Monero payment by making RPC call to the server
     * @param {Element} radio
     * @returns {Promise<Object>}
     * @private
     */
    async _processMoneroPayment(radio) {
        const amountTotal = document.getElementById('amount_total_summary');
        if (!amountTotal) {
            throw new Error("Missing order information");
        }

        const orderId = amountTotal.getAttribute('data-oe-id') || amountTotal.dataset.oeId;
        if (!orderId) {
            throw new Error("Missing order ID");
        }

        const providerId = this._getProviderId(radio);
        const providerCode = this._getProviderCode(radio);

        const endpoint = `/shop/payment/monero/process/${orderId}`;
        const response = await Utils.rpc(endpoint, {
            provider: providerId,
            provider_code: providerCode,
            order_sudo: parseInt(orderId),
            csrf_token: Utils.getCSRFToken(),
        }, { timeout: 30000 });

        if (!response || !response.payment_id) {
            throw new Error("Invalid response format");
        }

        this.currentPaymentId = response.payment_id;
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Display the Monero payment page
     * @param {Object} payment
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     * @private
     */
    async _displayMoneroPaymentPage(payment) {
        this._cleanupPaymentContainer();

        this.moneroPaymentContainer = document.createElement('div');
        this.moneroPaymentContainer.id = 'monero_payment_container';
        this.moneroPaymentContainer.className = 'monero-payment-container';

        this.element.parentNode.insertBefore(this.moneroPaymentContainer, this.element.nextSibling);
        this.element.style.display = 'none';

        this.moneroPaymentContainer.innerHTML = MONERO_PAYMENT_TEMPLATE;
        this._populatePaymentData(payment);
        await this._setupPaymentEventListeners();

        if (payment.state === 'pending' || payment.state === 'paid_unconfirmed') {
            this._startStatusChecking(payment.payment_id);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Populate payment data into UI elements
     * @param {Object} payment
     * @private
     */
    _populatePaymentData(payment) {
        const amountElement = document.getElementById('payment_amount_str');
        const addressElement = document.getElementById('seller_address');
        const referenceElement = document.getElementById('order_reference');

        if (amountElement) amountElement.textContent = payment.amount_str || '';
        if (addressElement) addressElement.textContent = payment.address_seller || '';
        if (referenceElement) referenceElement.textContent = payment.order_ref || 'N/A';
    }

    /**
     * Set up event listeners for the payment page
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     * @private
     */
    async _setupPaymentEventListeners() {
        const checkStatusBtn = this.moneroPaymentContainer.querySelector('#check_status_btn');
        if (checkStatusBtn) {
            checkStatusBtn.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                this._manualCheckStatus();
            });
        }
    }

    /**
     * Start periodically checking payment status
     * @param {string} paymentId
     * @private
     */
    _startStatusChecking(paymentId) {
        this._stopStatusChecking();
        const checkInterval = this.moneroPaymentContainer.querySelector('.alert-warning') ? 30000 : 60000;
        this.statusCheckInterval = setInterval(
            () => this._checkPaymentStatus(paymentId),
            checkInterval
        );
    }

    /**
     * Stop checking payment status
     * @private
     */
    _stopStatusChecking() {
        if (this.statusCheckInterval) {
            clearInterval(this.statusCheckInterval);
            this.statusCheckInterval = null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Manually trigger a payment status check
     * @private
     */
    _manualCheckStatus() {
        if (this.currentPaymentId) {
            this._checkPaymentStatus(this.currentPaymentId);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Check the payment status via RPC call
     * @param {string} paymentId
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     * @private
     */
    async _checkPaymentStatus(paymentId) {
        try {
            const status = await Utils.rpc(`/shop/payment/monero/status/${paymentId}`, {}, {
                timeout: 10000
            });

            if (status.status === 'confirmed' || status.confirmations >= 2) {
                this._updateStatusDisplay({
                    status: 'confirmed',
                    status_message: "Payment confirmed! Thank you for your purchase.",
                    status_alert_class: "success",
                    status_icon: "fa-check-circle"
                });
                this._stopStatusChecking();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`${DEBUG_TAG} Status check failed:`, error);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update the status display with new data
     * @param {Object} status
     * @private
     */
    _updateStatusDisplay(status) {
        const statusMessageEl = this.moneroPaymentContainer.querySelector('#status_message');
        if (statusMessageEl) {
            statusMessageEl.textContent = status.status_message;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clean up the payment container
     * @private
     */
    _cleanupPaymentContainer() {
        this._stopStatusChecking();
        
        if (this.clipboard) {
            this.clipboard.destroy();
            this.clipboard = null;
        }
        
        if (this.moneroPaymentContainer) {
            this.moneroPaymentContainer.remove();
            this.moneroPaymentContainer = null;
        }
        
        this.element.style.display = '';
    }

    /**
     * Update the pay button text
     * @param {string} text
     * @private
     */
    _updatePayButtonText(text) {
        if (this.submitButton) {
            this.submitButton.textContent = text;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Disable the payment form
     * @private
     */
    _disablePaymentForm() {
        if (this.submitButton) {
            this.submitButton.disabled = true;
        }
        
        this.element.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(el => el.disabled = true);
        Utils.blockUI();
    }

    /**
     * Enable the payment form
     * @private
     */
    _enablePaymentForm() {
        if (this.submitButton) {
            this.submitButton.disabled = false;
        }
        
        this.element.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(el => el.disabled = false);
        Utils.unblockUI();
    }

    /**
     * Get the provider code from a radio button
     * @param {Element} radio
     * @returns {string}
     * @private
     */
    _getProviderCode(radio) {
        return radio.dataset.providerCode;
    }

    /**
     * Get the provider ID from a radio button
     * @param {Element} radio
     * @returns {number}
     * @private
     */
    _getProviderId(radio) {
        return parseInt(radio.dataset.providerId);
    }

    /**
     * Clean up when instance is destroyed
     */
    destroy() {
        if (this.submitButton) {
            this.submitButton.removeEventListener('click', this._boundOnSubmitPayment);
        }

        const paymentRadios = this.element.querySelectorAll('input[name="o_payment_radio"]');
        paymentRadios.forEach(radio => {
            radio.removeEventListener('change', this._boundOnPaymentMethodSelected);
        });

        this._cleanupPaymentContainer();
        console.debug(`${DEBUG_TAG} Payment form destroyed`);
    }
}
